_README: Every selector the recorder uses lives here, never inline in a script — one place to fix when the
UI moves. A script refers to a FIELD NAME; record.mjs resolves it through this map and fails loudly
with the field name if it is missing.
Verified against live redoshq.com on 2026-08-06. REDOS ships no data-testid attributes, so these are
structural/text locators. If a run starts failing on 'not found' rather than on a wrong number, the
UI moved and this file is what needs editing — not the asserts.
maxOfferRow: div:has(> span:text-is("Max offer to hit your target"))
_quick: /quick is a narrow centred app column (~460px), not a wide marketing page. Clipping a still to quickCard avoids a frame that is two-thirds black. Set the still's clip back to null for a full 1920x1080 frame.
_analyze_surface: the signed-in analyzer — kept so the work-order script resolves, NOT reachable anonymously
